alt: Four side-by-side panels of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis: hypothalamic CRH drives pituitary ACTH, which drives adrenal corticosteroid, and corticosteroid inhibits both the hypothalamus and the pituitary. Panel 1 is normal. Panel 2 is primary adrenal insufficiency (the adrenal cortex is the damaged organ, so CRH and ACTH rise while corticosteroid falls). Panel 3 is secondary (pituitary damaged, so ACTH and corticosteroid fall). Panel 4 is tertiary (hypothalamus damaged, so CRH, ACTH and corticosteroid all fall).
